mapper.select: SELECT id, route_id, stop_id, order_id, customer_id, order_no_snapshot, assignment_status, fulfillment_status, signed_at, sign_reason FROM xsy_delivery_route_order WHERE deleted = FALSE AND assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND order_id IN #{orderId}

SELECT ro.order_id, ro.route_id, ro.fulfillment_status, ro.signed_at, ro.sign_reason, r.route_no, r.route_name, r.delivery_date, r.status AS route_status, r.warehouse_name_snapshot, r.driver_name_snapshot, r.driver_phone_snapshot, r.vehicle_no_snapshot, r.planned_departure_time, r.dispatched_at, r.completed_at FROM xsy_delivery_route_order ro JOIN xsy_delivery_route r ON r.id = ro.route_id AND r.deleted = FALSE WHERE ro.deleted = FALSE AND ro.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ro.order_id IN #{orderId}
